$comment: #EXP-2027 THE SIDEBAR TREE (owner 2026-11-20), web md+ and the desktop IDE (phones keep their own nav until their new UI; web-mobile = phones). There is NO active team: the sidebar is one tree, the current team of a screen is DERIVED from what it shows (a board's, agent's, app's or session's team), never switched (the team switcher, `exp.lastVisited.teamSlug` and the desktop `Navigation.team_id` state are gone). The pure reference is `src/sidebar-tree.ts`; web and desktop (Rust `domain::sidebar_tree`) replay every list here and compare the WHOLE expected value. ROOT (`root`, sidebarRootRows): `home` (the agent composer page, renamed from Agent), `needs-you` (only while its count > 0), `chats`, `drafts` (only while its count > 0), `devices`, then the `Teams` label (its hover + opens `teamsMenu`: New team, Join team) and one TEAM row per team. HOME's composer: the Assistant sees every team (its Teams pick, null = all); a team agent's chat is its agent's team; a plain chat (no agent) carries the Teams pick in the composer's + menu (eagent tree.json: its own team + the pick; at least one team). DEVICES (`devices`, sidebarDeviceRows): an expandable row with NO nav target (a press folds it; its hover + opens the Add device dialog), open by default (`openKeys.devices`); its children = the viewer's own devices by name (case-insensitive, ties by id), then teammates' servers shared with a team of the viewer's (devices-list.json `team`) by name, each such row carrying `teamId` = the first of its shared teams in the viewer's team order (drawn as that team's mark in the trailing slot); offline rows are `muted`. A device row opens the device's DETAIL page (accounts with their limits, the sessions running on it across teams with each row's team mark; on the viewer's THIS device also Tools, Coding CLIs, Worktrees and Sessions, which leave Settings); its hover gear opens the device SETTINGS page (the old Device settings dialog's body as a page). The Devices page is gone. TEAMS (`teams`, sidebarTeams): the viewer's member teams by name (case-insensitive, ties by id); the personal team (`kind: personal`, the Assistant's home) never shows. A team row's leading glyph is the team mark (its image, else the team concept icon), it is open by default (`openKeys.team`), has no nav target (a press folds it), its trailing slot shows the team's needs-you count (nav-badges.json) and on hover a `…` button; the `…` and a right-click open `teamMenu`. TEAM MENU (`teamMenu`, sidebarTeamMenu): `New` › board | agent | app | session (settings-nav.json `newEntries`: board, agent, app are owner-only; session = every member), `New folder`, `Settings` (the team's settings page, settings-nav.json `desktopNavs.team`). New › X opens a creation PAGE (never a dialog): web `/t/$teamSlug/new/<kind>`, desktop the matching screen; session = Home's composer with that team as its Teams pick. New folder appends an empty folder named `New folder` at the end of the team and puts its name in edit (a folder with no item is SHOWN while it is being named, then hidden like any empty folder). INSIDE A TEAM (`teamItems`, sidebarTeamItems): ONE MIXED list per team (sidebar-folders.json section `team`): boards by sortOrder, then agents (role agent; Assistants and an app's own agent never show: chats.json `sidebarAgents`) by sortOrder, then apps by name, then the root SESSIONS of that team the member placed (an item entry whose target is a visible root session of the team; ended ones stay until removed), in entry order. sidebar-folders.json's tree / move / ungroup / rows run unchanged over that list (two layers inside a team: folder › item). The team row is depth 0, so a node's List depth = its sidebarRows depth + 1 (`teamRows`, maxDepth 3). An item never leaves its team: a move whose target is in another team is refused (the List is one per team). SESSIONS INTO THE TREE (`drop`, sidebarDropSession): a root session of the team dragged from the Active band or the Chats list onto the team's List = the session appended to the team's items, then sidebarMove (so before / after / into work as for any row); a session of another team is refused (null); a session already in the tree is a plain move. A session item's menu holds `Remove from sidebar` (deletes its entry); boards, agents and apps keep their own menus (agent: chat-menus; board: its settings gear) and are never removed. ACTIVE stays at the bottom across all teams (sidebar-running, each row with its team mark). Pinned is gone ×4. The kind of an item is never stored: target ids are uuids, a client resolves an id against its synced boards / agents / apps / sessions (the server checks the target is one of the team's when it saves). OPEN KEYS are device-local like the folders' (no stored flag = open).

root.name: nothing pending: the five fixed rows minus the conditional ones
needs you and drafts show while they count

devices.name: mine by name, then teammates' shared servers with the first shared team of mine
a teammate's device shared with no team of mine never shows
ties by name keep id order

teams.name: member teams by name, the personal team never shows

teamMenu.name: an owner gets every New entry

teamItems.name: boards, agents, apps, then placed sessions

teamRows.name: the team row at depth 0, its nodes one deeper
a closed team shows only its row (count = its top-level nodes)

drop.name: a session dropped into a folder
a session of another team is refused
a child session is refused (roots only)
a session already in the tree is a plain move
